intent: Bounded Fabric medallion contract for the Supply Chain Decision View proof surface.
transport_note: CSV is the initial loading payload only. Canonical contracts remain schema-first.
transition_note: Current implementation still uses the repo-approved package as the Bronze input, while the active public-site source is now a bounded Fabric-derived serving extract mirrored into the site repo. The remaining bounded gap is that the extract is currently materialized from bounded Gold reference outputs rather than from a same-pass fully live Fabric runtime refresh.
